newsitem.title: USA: Houghten, Chugai in drug discovery pact.
newsitem.headline: Houghten, Chugai in drug discovery pact.

text.p: Houghten Pharmaceuticals Inc said Wednesday it has entered a drug discovery collaboration and license agreement with a unit of Chugai Pharmaceutical Co Ltd.

Houghten said the pact with Chugai Biopharmaceuticals Inc gives it upfront payments and potential milestones and royalties for any products Chugai develops from the collaboration using Houghten's resources.
Likewise, the company said it will pay Chugai royalties for any products it develops from the pact using Chugai's resources.
The company did not provide an estimate of the dollar value of the agreement.

"The agreement provides both short- and long-term funding opportunities, as well as scientific expertise in strategic areas of interest to HPI," Houghten said in a release, adding that the move helps it take "a significant step toward becoming a fully integrated drug discovery company."
